entries.title: 07/27 Log
entries.body:
# Microservices DAQ test with the triplet module:

Confirmed some setup things:
- Polarity of TX 0 has to be NOT INVERTED
- Polarity of all RX has to be NOT INVERTED
- The DP cable must plug to the 2nd port of the Zaza board (tried 1st and 3rd, no communication)
- Don’t even see the single elink at 8 when plugged to 1st Port now (Why do we see it before?)
- -o /data in scanConsole to save data locally not in container only
- tx in connectivity has to be 0 (2 will show no communication; 1 will be an even worse error due to it’s not defined in felix_config.json as tx)
- rx on connectivity can be 4, 8, 12. 16 won’t work (not sure if it’s cuz 17 is not included in the felix_config.json)
- Need SerEnLane=7; SerEnLane=1 gives error
